versions.short: The bill would add definitions to Title IX of the Education Amendments of 1972, the federal law banning sex discrimination in schools that receive federal funding. It would define sex as an individual's biologically determined sex, male or female, and would define male and female based on the reproductive system each produces, carries, and uses for fertilization. The changes would take effect when the bill is enacted and would apply to education programs and activities that receive federal financial assistance on or after that date.
